glossary.definition: The user API key pair from the Privilege console's Settings → For Developers. Sent as x-api-key and x-api-secret headers. The secret is write-only in this app: never returned, never logged.
Every call this app made — ok, refused, blocked or error — persisted redacted. The API secret is never in it.
An in-process mock of the Privilege console API on loopback: imodel-shaped sample tenant, illustrative not a recording. Write calls change only that in-memory sample.
The runtime guard that refuses every non-loopback socket, DNS lookup, fetch and UDP send. A Real call holds a permit for its own console origin only, while the operation runs.
The REST API of PingOne Privilege's console, under /api/{tenant}/v1. This app renders all 447 operations from the console's own swagger and runs them read-only by default.
x-procyon-session-id: a required correlation header on every console call. Structurally required; its value is unvalidated by the console. This app mints a fresh UUID per call.
GET calls run; POST and PUT need the per-connection writes switch; DELETE and PATCH always need it. A blocked call is answered 403 writes_disabled and audited.
The banner on every page names the mode and says what is simulated. Mock-issued answers are labelled as an illustrative sample, not a recording.
The console API's swagger (imodel.swagger.json, Swagger 2.0) reduced to 447 operations across 92 services. Searched by substring across method, path, service and summary.
The Privilege tenant UUID that appears in the console URL. Spliced into every operation's path template by this app from the saved connection.

cards.label: Audit log
cards.description: Every call, allowed or blocked, redacted. The API secret is never in it.

cards.label: Run an operation
cards.description: Fill the spec's parameters, press Call, and the result pane shows the HTTP status, elapsed ms, the exact path and the raw body, in real time.

cards.label: Connect to a console
cards.description: A connection names the console origin, the tenant UUID and the API key/secret pair. The secret is write-only. Mock: the in-process mock console.

cards.label: Diagram
cards.description: Browser, app, mock and real console. Movable boxes, Simulate, Reset, speed.

cards.label: Browse the API
cards.description: All 447 console operations from the swagger catalog. Search is a substring match — "pi" shows every pi* path; narrow by service or method.

cards.label: Read-only by default
cards.description: GET runs; POST and PUT need the writes switch; DELETE and PATCH always need it. Blocked calls are honest and audited.

diagrams.label: Browser, app, mock console, real console
